positions.title: Staff Software Engineer (ai framework)
positions.description:
- OpenVino GPU plugin : Developing OpenVino GPU plugin for accelerating neural networks as a technical lead. Enabling and optimizing NN models at graph level as well as kernel level. 

- Vision SW projects for VPU : Developed and optimized neural networks and object trackers for vliw processors and NN accelerators as a technical lead. 

- Also in a maintainer role for gpu plugin of Openvino repository (https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Compiler)
positions.description: SRP (Samsung Reconfigurable Processor) project : Developed and optimized SRP's compiler backends for VLIW & CGRA architectures on top of the LLVM framework.  In particular, developed optimization passes such as operation clusterizer for the clustered VLIW architectures and superblock scheduler, etc.
